policy: European Longfellow owns reusable Google-derived cryptographic primitives; downstreams consume exported installed targets.

primitives.name: native-tree-and-compressed-path
primitives.rule: MerkleTree constructs paths and MerkleTreeVerifier verifies them; SD-JWT has no local tree or path algorithm.

primitives.name: fixed-depth-circuit-membership
primitives.rule: SD-JWT aliases and invokes the installed generic relation only.

primitives.name: sha256-and-bit-packing
primitives.rule: No SD-JWT SHA path circuit or packing duplicate is allowed.

primitives.name: path-adaptation-and-witness-generation
primitives.rule: The installed adapter host-verifies and converts one native compressed proof.

primitives.name: canonical-native-circuit-vectors
primitives.rule: SD-JWT maintains no divergent Merkle vector corpus.

primitives.name: status-leaf-and-snapshot-policy
primitives.rule: Leaf domain encoding, issuer binding, epoch, and validity window are application policy, not Merkle primitives.
